combat_scope: Bounded caller-declared Crimson Hexblade runtime model. For each connected parent packet on an equipped wearer whose action metadata explicitly carries ntesim.trigger.parry_attack, the runner emits one separate Incantation ATK-scaled child at the parent delivery time and target. The child has an independent damage receipt and per-hit crit draw, uses standard damage calculation, and receives pre-hit modifiers selected by ordinary packet-metadata rules; native eligibility of those modifiers is unknown. Its target HP loss is applied, but post-hit callbacks (ordinary-hit energy, character/gear/Fireflies callbacks, Break and target-defeat callbacks) are omitted because native eligibility is unknown. The parent's packet and receipt remain unchanged. This does not model native Parry admission or claim native passive coverage.

GE_Fork_yaodao_Skill_Damage.unit: absolute ATK coefficient (bIsPercent display hint, no unit conversion)

independent_oracles: At 1000 ATK, DEF0, RES0, no damage bonuses and zero crit, the frozen T1 ratio 2/1 yields a separate child with 2000 exact damage.
At the same pinned inputs, the frozen T3 ratio 13/5 yields a separate child with 2600 exact damage.
At the same pinned inputs, the frozen T5 ratio 16/5 yields a separate child with 3200 exact damage.

A research-only 1/2 crit-rate case declares independent per-target-hit sampling for the parent and child; the actor RNG stream records two draws at indices 0 and 1. This verifies runner RNG separation only, not native crit policy.
known_gaps: Native Parry event admission, attribution and legal action/resource costs are not modeled; the exact ntesim.trigger.parry_attack action tag is a caller declaration.
Native child multiplicity across multi-hit and multi-target actions, delivery timing, target selection, crit/RNG, damage-bonus eligibility and post-hit callback eligibility are unknown.
The bounded child omits energy, character/gear/Fireflies, Break and target-defeat callbacks. These omissions make no claim that native behavior excludes them.
The separate packet ratio is source-backed; global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
